name: HR, Hiring & Team Management
summary: Hire faster, onboard consistently, and keep certifications, shifts, and timesheets on track.
description: People operations are full of repeatable steps that still get handled by hand: scheduling interviews, collecting new hire paperwork, chasing timesheets, tracking certifications, and routing time-off requests. These automations give every candidate and employee the same reliable process, alert managers before a license or certification lapses, and take the reminders off HR's plate.
